question: Which of the following Hero Indian Super League teams appointed Sergio Lobera as its head coach in October 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai City FC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mumbai City FC** on 10 October 2020 announced the appointment of a new **Head Coach, Sergio Lobera, **before the Hero Indian Super League (Hero ISL) 2020/21 season.
 
• He replaced **Jorge Costa.**
 
• He belongs to Spain and has coached different leagues around the world in a career spanning almost **25 years**
 
• Lobera has managed clubs in Spain, Morocco, and India and also had a spell as** assistant manager of FC Barcelona in 2012.**
 
• Before joining the Mumbai team he was the coach of **Goa Football Club**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The team** Mumbai City Football Club was formed in 2014 and owned by Ranbir Kapoor, Vimal Parekh, and the City Football group**.
 
• **Des Buckingham **is the current coach of Mumbai City FC.
 
• **Indian Super League 2020-21** was won by **Mumbai City FC**
